Sizing a conveyor is not choosing a length from the catalog. It is answering five questions in the right order: what will go on it, how much per hour, from where to where, at what incline and in what environment. When these five answers are clear, the project comes out right and the machine works full shifts with no improvisation. When one is missing, rework appears: a belt that overflows, a motor that trips, product rolling back to the foot of the conveyor.
Este guia mostra como fazemos esse dimen: This guide shows how we do this sizing in practice, with the vocabulary our engineering team uses in the first contact with the customer. At the end, you use the website calculator to see the reference numbers for your operation.

O material define quase tudo no projeto:: The material defines almost everything in the project: belt profile, width, speed, sealing and even the structural material. Describe the product as concretely as possible.
Sacaria, caixa e volume fechado: carga q: Bags, boxes and closed packages: loads that rest fully on the belt, usually on a smooth belt.
Granel seco, como grão e fertilizante: r: Dry bulk, such as grain and fertilizer: performs better on a V belt, which forms a trough and avoids loss at the sides.
Material solto em subida: pede correia t: Loose material going uphill: calls for a cleated belt, otherwise the load comes down as the conveyor runs.
Resíduo e reciclagem: peça irregular, co: Waste and recycling: irregular items, cuts and metal tips call for a sturdier belt and a well-adjusted scraper.
Alimento e produto lavável: correia atóx: Food and washable product: non-toxic belt, stainless or galvanized structure and a design made for sanitation.
Dois detalhes que mudam o projeto e quas: Two details that change the project and almost always get left out of the first e-mail: moisture and particle size. Wet product sticks, cakes and slides differently. Fine powder calls for sealing and care with leaks at the joints.
2. Defina a capacidade pelo pico, não pe: 2. Define capacity by the peak, not the average
A conta certa não é o volume do dia divi: The right calculation is not the day's volume divided by the hours. It is the peak: the moment when two trucks arrive together and the line has to take everything without forming a queue. Size for the peak and the operation never becomes a bottleneck.
Traduza a capacidade em uma unidade que: Translate capacity into a unit you already use: tons per hour, bags per hour, boxes per minute or packages per shift. Any of them works, as long as it is a real number you have seen happen in your operation.
3. Meça a distância e a altura de descar: 3. Measure the distance and the discharge height
Comprimento e altura são as duas medidas: Length and height are the two measurements that define the size of the machine. Measure the path the product has to cover, from the feed point to the drop point, and the height of the discharge point above the floor: the edge of the truck body, the hopper mouth, the silo inlet or the sorting table.
Se a altura de descarga muda ao longo do: If the discharge height changes during the day, there is a solution: articulated conveyor, base with casters or height adjustment. Say so at the start and the project is born with the right flexibility.
Inclinação é onde mais se erra. Quanto m: Incline is where most mistakes happen. The steeper it is, the lower the real capacity and the greater the force the motor has to deliver. Going uphill with loose material, a smooth belt sends the load back. The rule of thumb: a steeper climb calls for cleats, and any change of incline after the project requires recalculating capacity and drive.
Existe um caminho quase sempre melhor qu: There is a path that is almost always better than increasing the incline: increasing the length. A longer, less inclined conveyor works lighter, uses less belt and trips less.
5. Descreva o ambiente e a rotina: 5. Describe the environment and the routine
A mesma máquina em galpão coberto e em p: The same machine in a covered warehouse and in an open yard has a different design. Dust, moisture, sun, water washdown, corrosive product, temperature and number of starts per day all go into the calculation. An operation with many full-load starts calls for spare motor capacity; an environment with washdown calls for stainless steel and a suitable belt.

These imperfections not only compromise the efficiency of material handling but can also result in more serious failures in the system. For example, cracks and tears in the belt can lead to sudden breakage, interrupting the operation and causing production delays. Likewise, roller misalignment can cause irregular, excessive wear, increasing the likelihood of mechanical failures.
É fundamental que os operadores estejam: It is essential that operators watch for any signs of wear and carry out regular inspections. Early detection of problems, such as visible cracks, tears or roller misalignment, can be the key to avoiding greater damage and high corrective maintenance costs. This can lead to premature wear of parts and, in more serious cases, to the unexpected stoppage of the equipment, causing interruptions to operations and losses.
Por isso, é fundamental realizar a limpe: For that reason, it is essential to clean the conveyor regularly.
